skill.name: pptx-official
skill.description: Create, edit, analyze, validate, and review PowerPoint .pptx files using HTML, PptxGenJS, OOXML, and local helper scripts.
skill.summary: Create, edit, analyze, and validate PowerPoint presentations with PPTX and OOXML workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from OOXML namespaces, Markdown examples, schema files, and JavaScript template strings. Confirmed risks remain in unsafe ZIP extraction, privileged install guidance, and local converter execution on Office files. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed skill files. Static review was capped at 400/506 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 106 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Unsafe archive extraction in Office unpacking and validation scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Replace extractall with a safe extraction helper that rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, and symlink entries.

remediation.issue: Privileged package installation is shown in the skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Move sudo apt-get commands to manual setup documentation and require explicit user confirmation before installation.

remediation.issue: Local conversion tools process user-supplied presentation files.
remediation.suggestion: Run LibreOffice and Poppler conversions in a sandboxed temporary workspace with timeouts and clear trust warnings.

content.value_statement: PowerPoint work is difficult when slides need layout, XML, or template changes. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PPTX creation, editing, validation, and review.
actual_capabilities: Creates new presentations from HTML slides through the html2pptx workflow.
Edits existing presentations by unpacking and modifying OOXML files.
Validates presentation packages with included OOXML validation scripts.
Generates thumbnail grids for visual review of slide layout issues.
Extracts and replaces slide text while preserving shape structure.
Rearranges, duplicates, and removes slides through template workflows.
limitations: Requires local dependencies such as PptxGenJS, Playwright, LibreOffice, and Poppler.
Complex layouts may need several visual validation passes.
Direct OOXML edits can corrupt files when validation is skipped.
Helper scripts process local files and should not be used on untrusted decks without safeguards.

use_cases.title: Build a New Slide Deck
use_cases.description: Create a structured PowerPoint deck from an outline, with HTML-based layouts and visual validation.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Branded Template
use_cases.description: Reuse an existing template, map content to slide designs, and replace text while keeping branding intact.

use_cases.title: Repair Presentation Structure
use_cases.description: Inspect OOXML, fix broken relationships, validate package files, and rebuild a usable PPTX.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint deck from this outline. Use a clean visual style and generate thumbnails for review.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an Existing Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this PPTX file. Summarize the slide content, identify layout issues, and note missing speaker context.

prompt_templates.title: Update a Template Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this template deck and this new content. Preserve the template style, replace text, and validate the final file.

prompt_templates.title: Repair OOXML Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Unpack this presentation, inspect the OOXML relationships, fix structural errors, validate it, and repack the deck.

output_examples.input: Create a quarterly business review deck from a short outline.
output: A PowerPoint deck with title, agenda, performance, risks, and next steps slides.
A thumbnail grid for visual review.
A short note listing any layout changes made after validation.

output_examples.input: Update an existing sales template with new product messaging.
output: A revised deck that keeps template colors, fonts, and slide structure.
A replacement summary showing which slides changed.
A validation result noting whether the output file opened correctly.

output_examples.input: Find why a presentation has broken notes or missing images.
output: A relationship audit with affected slides identified.
A repair plan for missing media or notes references.
A repacked deck after structural fixes are applied.

best_practices: Keep a backup of the original presentation before unpacking or replacing content.
Run visual thumbnail validation after every major layout change.
Use OOXML editing only when higher-level PowerPoint libraries cannot make the needed change.
anti_patterns: Do not skip validation after direct XML edits.
Do not run helper scripts on unknown presentations without sandboxing.
Do not rely only on extracted text when layout or branding matters.

faq.question: Can this skill create new PPTX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide HTML-based slide creation and convert slides into PowerPoint files.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing PowerPoint deck?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports template workflows, text replacement, slide rearrangement, and direct OOXML edits.

faq.question: Does it require Microsoft PowerPoint?
faq.answer: No. The workflows use local scripts, OOXML, LibreOffice, Poppler, and JavaScript libraries.

faq.question: Can it preserve a template design?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect theme files, create thumbnails, and map new content to existing slide layouts.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with untrusted PPTX files?
faq.answer: Use caution. Some helper scripts unpack archives or invoke converters, so sandbox untrusted files first.

faq.question: Does it validate the final presentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes validation steps and thumbnail review to catch structural and visual issues.
